artifact: Hash-only evidence manifest for the quarantined raw OEF holdings file
availability_verification_method: re-hashed in place; byte count and SHA-256 both matched the value recorded at retrieval
location_note: Repository-external quarantine directory on the machine that performed the retrieval. A reviewer with access to that machine can hash the file directly; a reviewer without it can re-download from the official URL and compare, accounting for the fund's daily republication.
purpose: The raw fund-holdings file is NOT tracked by Git because it carries prohibited numeric holdings fields. This manifest lets an independent reviewer verify its recorded SHA-256 without the repository ever containing those values.
